title: Source-verified recorder UTC selector for AOP-005
description: Closed recordings selector over one independently pinned native replay receipt. The local operator binds deployment/archive roots and principal, and separately permits original-source verification. MCP clients cannot grant that permission or override owner scope. Actual source reads require a query-bound CAP-READ-MEDIA-001 authority in addition to CAP-AGENT-QUERY-001. QueryPlan, AgentResponseEnvelope and AgentCognitiveEnvelope v1 remain the registered public contracts. Responses expose H0 evidence identities and recorder assertions; no media bytes, calibrated capture time, coverage or absence witness. Native parsing and bounds are authoritative.

utc_start_ns.description: Half-open recorder-asserted UTC interval start, lossless Unix nanoseconds. Native admission requires 0 <= start < end <= 253402300800000000000.

utc_end_ns.description: Exclusive recorder-asserted UTC interval end. This selector never reinterprets node-clock start_utc_ns/end_utc_ns.

max_query_source_bytes.description: Native payload reservation ceiling, 1..2147483648; every original reserves 32 MiB before reads.

max_query_results.description: Complete matches + unknown samples + source-only observations. No prefix success or omission on overflow; the complete protected response must also fit 256 KiB.

max_query_read_bytes.description: Whole-request archive read ceiling, 1..4294967296, including metadata, envelope and repeated verification reads. Does not enlarge the launcher source grant.

max_query_io_calls.description: Whole-request archive filesystem-call ceiling, 1..4000000. Does not enlarge the launcher source grant.

anchor.description: Exact current deployment authority/effect-history token; independent of the historical source anchor.
